name: io.github.toffguy77/mattermost-mcp
title: Mattermost
description: Mattermost: read unreads, mentions, channels and threads; opt-in posting, edits, reactions

environmentVariables.name: MATTERMOST_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Mattermost server, e.g. https://mattermost.example.com

environmentVariables.name: MATTERMOST_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Personal access token or bot token (Profile > Security > Personal Access Tokens)

environmentVariables.name: MATTERMOST_ENABLE_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable posting, replying, editing own posts and reactions (off by default)

environmentVariables.name: MATTERMOST_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Cookie mode: value of the MMAUTHTOKEN browser cookie (when personal access tokens are unavailable)

environmentVariables.name: MATTERMOST_CSRF
environmentVariables.description: Cookie mode: value of the MMCSRF browser cookie (required for write tools in cookie mode)
